verdict.rationale: Adyen documents agent-platform integrations that manage the full ACP and UCP checkout flows. Creating a checkout session returns a UCP envelope with totals and fulfillment options, and the Agentic Cart API defines session lifecycle calls such as commit and cancel. Creation of a cart or checkout session is clearly documented, but an explicit update-session call is only implied by the claim of managing the "full checkout flow". missing for 10: an explicitly documented update-cart/session call, request/response details for modifying line items, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can create and update a cart or order draft through a documented protocol call

citations.quote: Manage the full Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) checkout flow on behalf of Adyen merchants.
Manage the full Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) checkout flow on behalf of Adyen merchants.
Adyen returns the created session with UCP envelope, totals, and fulfillment options.
Commit session (optional): Run a final price or stock check before Adyen authorizes the payment.
Convert high intent AI-powered discovery into checkout-ready carts, with live pricing, tax, and shipping synced at the point of selection.
